# Microsoft Fluent UI System Icons

The generated `ic_fluent_*.xml` Android vectors come from Microsoft's official
`@fluentui/svg-icons` package version **1.1.328** (`fluentui-svg-icons-1.1.328.tgz`).

- npm package integrity: `sha512-QSfxXJ34s0wr+FopPdAh2RKfOi+6EmsgXbAgo7ho0disnzn+m3mS3Ol6Ln4iADZ4v6X3kcXrA0VsZeEzJPO0tQ==`
- npm tarball SHA-1: `2cfba1d6fd6d5c6155b6ca6c5f6420e1b0b88f39`
- upstream: <https://github.com/microsoft/fluentui-system-icons>
- license: MIT, copied in `LICENSE-MIT.txt`

Only a curated subset of filled 24 px icons is converted to Android VectorDrawable at build-source
time. The application never downloads icons at runtime. Stable `fluent_*` keys are persisted by the
same allow-listed catalog as the existing icons.
